detail.longDescription: 🐶 NEW: Recording 103 dogs in four situations, researchers found they tilted their heads far more often when owners used familiar words in an excited tone than during silent or unfamiliar # speech . The motion may signal active # language processing, possibly tied to the left # brain hemisphere, though the small number of tilting # dogs keeps conclusions appropriately cautious. 👉 https://www. popsci.com/environment/why-dog s-tilt-their-heads-ask-us-anything-podcast/ # science # animals # canines # research # behavior # kids # pets # nature
